text:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check for NimbusPay onboarding -> spike this AM, want to surface before renewal sync. Summary: overall error rate 4.2% (+0.9pt w/w). Breakdown: 5xx 52%, timeouts 28%, rate_limit 20%. Affected flows: bulk embeddings + batched uploads. Top failing endpoints below, please ACK and add ETA for fixes.

[log snippet]```
/v1/embeddings 1100 rate_limited (burst from acct-NIM-2)
/v1/batch-upload 340 timeouts (multipart job hang)
/v1/generate 260 5xx (model worker oom/retries)
/v1/stream 150 timeouts (stream connections stalled)
/v1/auth/token 45 5xx (upstream idp slow)
```

tom_sre: Saw the same. Correlation looks like several onboarding orgs kicked off parallel large-file uploads + embeddings which saturated the per-pool concurrency and hit our upstream redis timeouts. Autoscale reacted but with ~2m lag, causing retried requests and 5xx cascade. Quick mitigation: enabling per-customer burst window + increasing embedding pool concurrency for acct-NIM-2. ETA ~45m.

nina_onboard: We're running a multi-account import guide that suggests 500-item batches by default. I'll patch the guide to recommend 50-100 item chunks and include client-side exponential backoff. Also can we add a warning banner in the quickstart for bulk uploads?

raj_support: Customer ticket #CS-13190: NimbusPay PM reported repeated 500s during their import and asked for root cause and compensation options. They've paused the import and want confirmation before the renewal call. Marking renewal risk = HIGH unless we show improvement soon.

tom_sre: Deploying temporary pool concurrency bump for embeddings and enabling a degraded-mode fallback: if batch-size > 200, proxy to a background async job (enqueue + webhook) to avoid blocking user request path. Putting a throttling rule to surface 429s earlier instead of letting requests pile up. ETA for full change ~3h, temp bump done ~45m.

ops-bot: concurrency-config updated by tom_sre at 1773335000 (change-id: cfg-9090) :white_check_mark:

nina_onboard: I'll push the quickstart edits and add a short KB about chunking + backoff. ETA 2h.

raj_support: I've offered monitoring + a one-time import assistance session to the customer and asked if they want a test window after mitigations. They're receptive but need confirmation before we go to contract renewal.

maria_cs: Thanks. Actions recap: 1) SRE (tom) temporary bump + fallback (45m), longer change (3h). 2) Onboarding (nina) quickstart + KB (2h). 3) CS (raj/maria) customer comms + monitoring and note renewal risk = HIGH currently. Ping this thread when metrics show error-rate <1.0% for 24h. :pray:
